text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's see, what do I have to help out with today again? Harvesting crops in the school field, organizing paperwork, and shopping, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ouch… I'm getting a lot of headaches today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't just abandon my duties, though… Everyone is counting on me!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Kita! It's important to rest when you're sick, but the most important thing is having the determination to never give up.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: No matter how exhausted you are, you'll be able to pull through as long as you can sing with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir! I won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black accidentally manages to aggravate her headache.
